canDo: Can locate conditions, people concerned, times and restrictions under time pressure.
output: A 2-sentence summary of each, with the evidence sentences marked.
checkpoint: After the objective questions, can point to where the evidence is in the text.
challenge: Today’s challenge: find a real practical text in French (e.g. SNCF travel rules, car-hire terms or an annonce from TV5MONDE Apprendre B1). Scan it in a 5-minute time limit, find one each of “who it concerns, when, conditions, restrictions” and underline the evidence sentences; then write 3 sentences reporting these rules with qui / où / dont and one negative structure (ne… aucun, ne… que).

questions.why: « aucun retard n'est admis pour les épreuves collectives »; thirty minutes is how early you must arrive.
« sept nuits consécutives » is the limit for consecutive nights; ten nights is over it.

The foods the text lists for the coldest zone include opened cooked meats.
But it also must not stay at room temperature for more than two hours, so it has to be cooled quickly first.
What is given is an identity document and the parcel number.
Because it moved to the teaching pool and places are limited, you must book online 48 hours ahead.
120 euros were already used fourteen months ago, leaving 180 euros.
